_note: How much of a technique an onlooker can recover from the product or the working yard, by the node's category. A node's own copy_visibility and copy_visibility_reason in data/branches override its category. Each reason says what shows and what does not.

access.reason: Acquiring a site or planting stock is done in the open and who holds it shows; where the good sources are and how to keep the stock alive are not.

accounting.reason: Ledgers and statements pass between partners and auditors, so their form is copied by looking; the judgement in keeping them stays with the keeper.

agriculture.reason: Fields, rotations and tools lie in plain view of neighbours; the timing, soil judgement and seed quality that make them pay are not seen.

air.reason: An aircraft or its fitting is seen in flight and on the ground; the aerodynamic proportions and the handling that make it fly are not recovered by watching.

algebra.reason: A mathematical method lives in the heads of those who use it; an onlooker sees results and symbols but not the proofs and reasoning behind them.

alloys.reason: The mix of metals and the melting practice leave no trace in the finished metal; a look shows colour and weight, not composition.

analysis.reason: Analytical procedure is done behind laboratory doors; the numbers it yields are seen, the reagents, order and care that produce them are not.

analytical_chemistry.reason: A separation or measurement is done in glassware whose inner working shows nothing; only the result is carried out of the laboratory.

animal_traction.reason: Harness and fittings are worn in the open and every strap and joint can be seen and copied from the working animal.

animals.reason: Housing and handling of stock are seen from the road; the breeding records, feed ratios and cures behind the yield are not.

application.reason: A working appliance can be handled and its outline copied; the windings, materials and tolerances inside its casing are not seen.

armour.reason: Plate and its shape can be examined on the wearer; the hardening and the steel that make it turn a shot show only in the failure.

aviation.reason: A machine is seen in flight and on the ground; the wing section, balance and control feel that make it fly are not recovered by watching.

banking.reason: A bank takes and pays in public, so its forms are copied; reserves, lending judgement and the trust that sustain it are hidden.

benefaction.reason: A public work or endowment stands where all can see and use it; how it was financed, governed and kept up is not shown.

bicycles.reason: Every part of a bicycle is exposed and can be measured and copied; only the quality of its tubing and bearings is not told by sight.

binders.reason: Mortar, plaster and cement look alike once set; the source of the stone, the burning and the grinding that give them strength are not seen.

bridges.reason: A bridge is wholly in view and its form can be measured; the loads it was calculated for and the soundness of its foundations are not.

building_systems.reason: Rooms, stairs and visible fittings are plain to see; what lies in walls and floors, such as barriers, flues and pipes, is hidden.

buildings.reason: A completed building is open to view and walk through and can be measured; the way it was set out and the quality of its core are not shown.

calculation.reason: A calculating machine is seen in use and its keys and dials copied; the gearing and carry mechanism inside the case are not.

capability.reason: A sustained capability such as a heat, a gas supply or a purity is the sum of many practices; the output shows that it was reached, not how.

carriage_engineering.reason: Springs, axles, brakes and gearing of a carriage are exposed beneath it and can be measured and copied by looking.

casting.reason: A casting shows its shape and surface; the mould material, the melt and the cooling that made it sound are hidden in the foundry.

ceramics.reason: A fired body shows colour and form; the clay mix, glaze and firing schedule that produced it leave no clear trace.

chemical.reason: The effect of a chemical weapon or protection is plain; how the agent is made, held and delivered is kept behind works walls.

chemical_engineering.reason: A chemical works shows its vessels and pipes; the temperatures, pressures, flows and charges that make them yield are not visible.

chemistry.reason: A chemical fact is learned by repeating a preparation; an onlooker sees the glassware and the product, not the quantities and the order of working.

cinema.reason: A projector and a screen are seen at work; the film emulsion and the exact registration of frames are not recovered by watching.

circuit_concept.reason: A circuit is hidden inside a box and works only when its values and layout are right; its diagram is not on view.

cleaning.reason: A cleaning device or soap is used before the household and its working is evident; only the recipe of a compound may be hidden.

colour.reason: A colour print shows its result; the separations, inks and registration that make the colours agree are done out of sight.

comfort.reason: Furniture, glazing and fans stand in rooms where guests see them and every joint and part can be copied.

commerce.reason: Commercial practice is carried out in open markets and its forms are seen and imitated; the knowledge of whom to trust is not.

communications.reason: A field set or telephone is handled by many and its outside is copied; the circuit and the adjustment inside are not.

component.reason: A component is seen from outside and its size and ratings read from its markings; its construction inside is not.

composition.reason: A composing machine is seen working in the shop; its keyboard and matrices are copied less easily than its principle.

computing.reason: A computing machine's behaviour is seen from its outputs; the logic, coding and arrangement that produce them are inside.

connections.reason: Rivets, bolts, plates and welds are exposed on every structure and can be measured and copied by looking.

consumer_goods.reason: A household article can be bought and taken apart, so its form is copied at once; its materials and the way it is made at scale are not.

control.reason: A governor or regulator turns in plain sight and its linkage can be seen; the tuning that makes it stable is learned by trial.

control_theory.reason: A stability criterion or a tuning law is mathematics; machines that obey it show nothing of the reasoning behind them.

cooking.reason: A cooking vessel and its working are seen in the kitchen; only the fit of its closure and its safety valve need care to copy.

cooling.reason: A cooling cabinet is seen in the home; the sealed refrigerant circuit and its charge are not.

credit.reason: A bill or a cheque is a paper handed over and its form is copied; the standing of the names on it and the rules of acceptance are not.

crops.reason: A crop is grown in open fields and its husbandry watched; the treatment after harvest, such as pressing, boiling and drying, is done indoors.

cryptography.reason: A cipher is designed to show nothing; an onlooker sees only meaningless text, and the key and method stay with its users.

cutting.reason: A cutting tool shows its edge and shape; the steel, its hardening and the temper that keep that edge are not seen.

dairy.reason: Dairying is seen on the farm and in the shop; the cultures, temperatures and ageing that decide the product are not.

data_handling.reason: A tabulator or register is seen working in an office and its keys copied; the mechanism that carries and records is inside.

dentistry.reason: Dental work is done before the patient and the instruments are seen; the finer skill and the materials of fillings are not shown.

diagnosis.reason: An examination is watched by the patient and attendants; the training that reads its signs is not conveyed by watching.

diagnostics.reason: A diagnostic device is seen in use; its internal construction and the skill that interprets what it shows are not.

economic.reason: A change in how land or a farm is held shows in the landscape and the accounts neighbours hear of; the legal manoeuvre behind it does not.

electrical.reason: Wires, cells and lamps are seen; the materials, windings and insulation that make them efficient and safe are hidden in them.

electrical_auxiliary.reason: A charging set or converter is seen with its connections; the way its parts are matched is learned only by building one.

electrical_dist.reason: Insulators, fuses and breakers stand on poles and in panels in plain view and can be measured; their ratings are not told by sight.

electrical_gen.reason: A generator is seen turning and its frame copied; the winding pattern and magnetic circuit inside decide its output and are not.

electrical_storage.reason: A storage battery shows its case and terminals; the plates, the electrolyte and the forming that give it capacity are inside.

electronics.reason: A device is a sealed part whose function shows only in a circuit; the purity, doping and patterning that make it work leave no trace.

energy_storage.reason: A flywheel or a pumped store is a large visible structure whose layout is copied; the control and losses are not.

envelope.reason: Walls, glass and roofs are on view from the street and can be measured; the fixing and the quality of the material are less so.

environmental_chemistry.reason: A waste stream and its treatment are known to those who run the works; neighbours see the effect, not the process.

equipment.reason: A crane, mixer or mill stands at the site and its parts can be seen and measured; the strength of its members is not.

excavation.reason: Dredging and tunnelling are carried out in the open or at the face and the method is watched by crews and onlookers.

expedition.reason: A voyage's arrival and cargo are known to all; the route, the timing and the sources of supply are kept by the crew.

explosives.reason: The effect is plain to everyone; the proportions, purity and corning or nitration that make it safe and powerful cannot be seen in the product.

fermentation.reason: A vat is seen bubbling and its product tasted; the culture, temperature and timing that steer it are not.

fibres.reason: A fibre or cloth can be handled and identified; the preparing, retting and spinning that bring it to that state are mostly out of sight.

field_machinery.reason: A farm machine works in open fields before neighbours and every part can be seen and measured; only the steel quality is hidden.

finishes.reason: A finished floor or wall shows its pattern; the mix and the laying are done once and hidden under the surface.

finishing.reason: A finished surface shows its look; the bath, the current or the coat and the cleaning that produced it leave no trace.

fishing.reason: Fishing and whaling fleets work in view of harbours and their gear is seen; the grounds and the rendering of the catch are not.

forming.reason: A formed part shows its shape; the dies, heats and pressures that made it are in the shop and not in the product.

fortification.reason: A wall, ditch or bastion is open to every traveller and can be paced out and drawn.

foundation.reason: A practice of conduct or standard-setting shows in how its holder behaves; the intent and the method behind it do not.

foundations.reason: A foundation is buried once built; its method is seen only by those who watch the works.

fuel_advanced.reason: A propellant system burns in sight and the flame and thrust show; the mixture, pumping and control that make it work are not.

fuel_infrastructure.reason: A gas holder stands in the town and its construction is plain to see; only its sealing and pressure control are not.

fuel_processing.reason: A gasifier or a refinery is seen from outside; the fractions, temperatures and flows inside are not.

fuel_product.reason: The product, such as oil or spirit, is sold and burned in the open; the refining that makes it clean and consistent is not shown.

fuel_production.reason: Charcoal burning, mining and coking are watched by neighbours; the control of the burn and the winning of the best seam are not.

geometry.reason: A geometric construction can be redrawn from a drawing; the reasoning for why it holds is not seen.

glass_optics.reason: A glass or a lens shows its clearness and shape; the batch, melting and annealing or grinding that make it are not seen.

grid_operations.reason: A network's running practice such as frequency, load and power factor is kept in control rooms and shows only as steady supply.

harbours.reason: A dock or harbour work is large and open to every sailor and can be measured and drawn.

heat_treatment.reason: The heat that hardens or softens steel is read from its colour by the smith and leaves no trace in the finished piece.

heating.reason: Hearths, stoves and under-floor flues are seen in the house and can be copied; their draught takes some adjusting.

hydraulic_power.reason: Pipes, rams and accumulators are visible; the pressures and the packings that hold them are not.

ic_auxiliary.reason: Valves, injectors and chargers are seen when an engine is opened; the timing and clearances that make them work are not.

ic_prime.reason: An engine runs and is heard and seen; the cycle, the compression and the ignition timing are inside it.

industrial_process.reason: A works is entered by few and a process there shows only its output; the reactions, catalysts and conditions are not visible.

information.reason: A printed or copied text circulates and its form is copied; the press work and the sources behind it are not shown.

infrastructure.reason: Aqueducts, drains and mains are public works that can be walked along and measured; the levelling and the jointing are less plain.

ink.reason: Ink is seen on the page; the recipe and the grinding that give it body and blackness are kept by the maker.

institution.reason: An institution is seen in its dealings and buildings; its internal rules, funding and the habits that keep it working are not.

institutional.reason: A code or a plan is published or enforced in view of the town; the discretion applied in using it is not.

institutions.reason: A hospital, school or court is seen from outside and its forms copied; the training and discipline within it are not.

instruments.reason: An instrument can be seen in use and its form copied; the accuracy of its graduation and its materials are not.

insurance.reason: A policy's form is passed to the insured and copied; the odds, the tables and the reserves behind it are kept by the insurer.

intaglio.reason: A printed engraving shows its lines; the biting, the burin work and the inking that produced them are done in the studio.

investment.reason: A bond, share or contract is an instrument of paper and its terms are read; the valuation behind its price is not.

joining.reason: A joint shows its seam; the heat, filler, flux and preparation that made it hold are not seen afterwards.

knitting.reason: A knitting frame is open to view and its needles and action can be seen and copied; only the setting of the needles needs skill.

knowledge.reason: Understanding is held by those who have it; an onlooker sees the practice it supports but not the reasoning behind it.

lab_technique.reason: A technique is carried out at the bench; the care, the order and the sense of when it has worked are not seen.

laboratory.reason: A research apparatus is set up behind closed doors and its readings are seen by few; the design and the skill in using it are not.

labour.reason: A contract, wage rule or indenture is a form used in the open and copied; the leverage that makes it hold is not.

law.reason: A statute is written and read by anyone; how courts apply it and enforce it is learned only by watching many cases.

leather.reason: Leather shows its surface and feel; the tanning liquor, time and dressing are done in the yard, out of the sight of buyers.

leisure.reason: A game, toy or instrument is sold and handled openly and its form can be copied directly.

lighting.reason: A candle, lamp or fitting is seen lit in every room and can be copied; only the wick, fuel and glass quality are less obvious.

lithography.reason: A lithographic print shows its image; the stone or plate preparation and the inking are done in the studio.

livestock.reason: A breed is seen in the fold; the selection over generations that produced it is not shown in any animal.

located_material.reason: A crop or deposit is a known thing in a known place; how to find, grow or work it well is not shown.

luxury.reason: A gaming house or similar establishment operates in public and its trade is evident; the management and the odds are not.

machine.reason: A machine is seen running and its frame copied; the winding, the field and the clearances that give its performance are inside.

machine_tools.reason: A machine tool is seen at work and its parts can be copied; the accuracy built into its ways and spindles, by scraping and fitting, is not.

machines.reason: A machine stands in the shop and its form can be drawn; its precision, its materials and its adjustment are not told by its look.

manufacturing.reason: A mill or works is seen from outside; the arrangement of its stages and the speeds and charges are kept within.

marine.reason: Ships' hardware and rigging are seen at the quay and can be measured and copied; the handling and the strength of timbers are not.

marking.reason: A seal or stamp is plain on every sealed thing and the die can be copied.

material.reason: A material is seen as a lump or a sheet; the ore, the preparation, the purity and the process that produced it are not.

materials.reason: A lining or a plate is seen in service; the alloy, the glaze and the manner of making it are not.

mathematics.reason: A mathematical method is held in the mind and seen only in what is written; its proofs and uses are not conveyed by watching.

measurement.reason: An instrument is seen in use and its form copied; the graduation, the calibration and the standards it is checked against are not.

media.reason: An advertisement, directory or almanac is published for all to read and its form copied at once; the circulation and the revenue behind it are not.

media_base.reason: A writing surface can be handled and compared; the preparing, curing and finishing that make it durable are done out of sight.

medicine.reason: A hygienic rule or a clinical practice is seen applied; the theory that justifies it and the discipline that keeps it up are not.

metallurgy.reason: A furnace is seen to smoke and the metal to run; the charge, the blast and the timing that give a sound result are not.

metals.reason: A metal is seen as a bar or ingot; the ore, the reduction and the refining that produced it are done in the works, out of sight.

method.reason: A method of enquiry is written about and its form copied; the discipline in practising it is not.

metrology.reason: A gauge is seen and used, and its form copied; its accuracy and the reference it was set against are not.

milestone.reason: A milestone is a state of society, not a technique; what shows is its result, which all can see, not how it was brought about.

military.reason: A weapon or its use is seen in the field; the preparation, the training and the supply behind it are not.

milling.reason: A mill grinds before the town and its stones and rolls are seen; the dressing, the speeds and the sifting are not.

mineral_extraction.reason: The product, such as potash or phosphorus, is seen in sale; the extraction that yields it is done in the works.

mining.reason: Pitheads, engines and spoil heaps are visible and miners talk; the underground working and the reading of the ground are not.

money.reason: Coin and note are in every hand and their form and standard can be assayed and copied; the issuing policy is not.

motor_subsystems.reason: Parts are seen when a vehicle is opened; their clearances, materials and timing are not told by sight.

naval.reason: A warship lies in the harbour and its lines and armament are seen; its machinery, fire control and drill are not.

navigation.reason: A chart, tables or an instrument can be copied; the skill in using them and the observations they rest on are not.

notation.reason: A notation is learned at a glance wherever it is used and copied in a moment; why it was chosen is not needed.

obstetrics.reason: A birth is attended by few; the practice is learned from those who attended and the instruments, not from watching.

occupational_health.reason: A workplace rule or a ventilation fitting is seen; the evidence of harm that justified it is not.

oils.reason: Oil is pressed and sold in view of the market; the refining, hardening and mixing that fit it for use are done out of sight.

ophthalmology.reason: Spectacles are worn in the street and the lenses and frames can be copied; the testing that fits them is less seen.

optics.reason: A lens, mirror or coating is seen in the finished instrument; the figuring, polishing and deposition are done in the workshop.

organic_chemistry.reason: A synthesis is a series of reactions in glassware; the product shows nothing of the route, the reagents or the conditions.

organic_reaction.reason: A reaction is carried out in a flask and shows only its product; the reagents, temperature and order of addition are not seen.

organisation.reason: An organisation is seen in its dealings and its charter is read; the real division of power and the culture within are not.

organization.reason: An apprentice system or toolroom is seen in the shop; how skill is transmitted and checked is learned only by taking part.

paper.reason: A sheet shows its quality; the rags, the pulping, the sizing and the drying are done in the mill.

personal.reason: A personal article is worn or sold and can be examined and copied; the recipe of a scent or cosmetic is not.

pests.reason: A spray or a control is seen applied; its composition and the dose that works without harm are not.

pharmaceutical.reason: A tablet or powder shows nothing of the synthesis, the purification or the dose that makes it effective.

pharmacology.reason: A remedy is seen administered; its preparation, strength and the reading of its effect are held by the apothecary.

photography.reason: A picture is seen; the plate or film, the chemistry and the exposure and development that made it are out of sight.

physical_chemistry.reason: A law of equilibria or electrochemistry is learned from measurements and reasoning, not from watching a laboratory.

physics.reason: A physical law is held in the mind; apparatus shows an effect but not the theory that explains it.

plants.reason: Grafting, budding and pollinating are done in the garden in view; the choice of stock and the timing are less plain.

plastics.reason: A moulded plastic shows its form; the monomers, the polymerisation and the curing are done in the works.

polymer.reason: A polymer in use shows its feel and strength; the chemistry, the catalyst and the conditions that make it are not.

power.reason: A prime mover or its drive is seen working and its general form copied; the proportions that make it efficient are not.

power_station.reason: A station is a large structure that anyone can see and walk round; its operation and its controls are not.

power_system.reason: Switchyards and lines are seen; the protection settings, the dispatch and the earthing practice are inside the control room.

precision.reason: A precise piece is seen to run true; the tolerances, fits and fixtures that make it so are not shown by its look.

preservation.reason: A sealed can or a salted store is handled by buyers; the heating, the sealing and the timing that keep it safe are not.

press.reason: A press stands in the shop in view and its screw, bed and platen can be seen and copied.

prime_alternative.reason: An alternative motor is seen working and its general form copied; the proportions that make it work are not.

prime_experimental.reason: An experimental engine is seen to run and its thrust felt; the combustion, the materials and the control are inside it.

printing.reason: A printing office works in view and its press, type and forme are seen; the type metal and the inking take practice.

probability.reason: A probability rule is held in the mind and seen only in what it predicts; the argument for it is not.

processes.reason: A smelting, converting or plating process is seen as heat and smoke; the charge, the blast and the control are not.

processing.reason: The product of bottling or canning is sold and opened; the cleanliness, the heating and the timing that make it safe are done within.

product.reason: A chemical product is sold in a jar; nothing in it shows its raw materials, its route or its purification.

public_health.reason: A sewer, filter or clinic is seen and its form copied; the dose, the sampling and the discipline of keeping it working are not.

publishing.reason: A newspaper is sold in every street and its form, columns and layout are plain to copy.

radar.reason: A radar set shows a screen and an aerial; the oscillator, the waveguide and the timing that make it see are inside the case.

radio.reason: An aerial and a receiver are seen; the tuned circuits and the valves that select a signal are inside and their values are not.

rail.reason: Track, locomotives and signals are on open display and can be measured and copied; the metallurgy and operating practice are not.

refining.reason: A refined metal is judged by assay; the electrolyte, the current and the control that gave its purity are not seen.

refrigeration.reason: An ice house or a cold store is seen and its insulation copied; the handling and the economics of the chain are not.

relief.reason: A carved block or a relief print shows exactly how it was cut and can be copied by looking.

reproduction.reason: A plate is seen as a mould for printing; the casting and finishing that make it true are done in the foundry.

roads_surfaces.reason: A road's camber, drains and surface are in view for all who travel it and can be copied.

rope_cordage.reason: Strands and lay of a rope are visible, and the ropewalk works in the open; only the tension and tarring need care.

safety.reason: A conductor or a rod is mounted on the roof in view and can be copied; its grounding is buried.

sanitation.reason: Latrines, traps and piped baths are in the house and can be seen and copied; the pipework behind walls is not.

scripting.reason: A scribe copies before onlookers and the script, the pen and the page are plain to see.

security.reason: A lock and key are handled openly; the wards and the tumblers inside are made to resist being read.

semiconductor.reason: A diode or crystal shows nothing of its refining, doping or contacts; its working is told only by a test circuit.

serology.reason: A vaccination is seen given; the preparation, the attenuation and the dose that protect are not.

sewing.reason: A sewing device is open to view and its needle, loop and feed can be seen and copied; only the timing of its parts needs care.

ships.reason: A hull and its rig lie at the quay and can be measured and copied; the lines that give its sailing qualities are less plain.

signalling.reason: A signal station, flag or lamp is seen working and the code learned by watching; the apparatus behind it is less plain.

smelting.reason: A furnace is seen from outside; the charge, the draught and the tapping that give the iron or steel are not.

social.reason: A status, patron or concession is known to the town; how it was gained and what it requires in return are not.

soil.reason: A dressing is seen spread on the field and its effect on the crop seen; its source, its preparation and its dose are less plain.

sound.reason: A recorder or player is seen working and its form copied; the cutting, the pickup and the amplification are inside.

spectacle.reason: A theatre, race or sport is held before crowds and every feature of the show is seen and copied.

spinning.reason: A spinning frame is open to view with its spindles and rollers; only the setting and speed need practice.

steam_auxiliary.reason: Valves, condensers and gear are seen on the engine; their proportions and the timing of the valves are not.

steam_boiler.reason: A boiler's shell and flues are seen from outside; the plate quality, the riveting and the water practice that keep it safe are not.

steam_prime.reason: A steam engine is seen working and its beam, cylinder and crank copied; the proportions and valve gear that make it efficient are not.

stone.reason: Quarrying and dressing are done in the open and the sawing, wedging and polishing are watched by anyone.

storage.reason: A memory device shows its drum, core or tape; the recording, reading and timing that make it reliable are not.

structural.reason: Beams, arches and trusses are in full view and can be measured and drawn; the loads they were designed for are not.

structures.reason: A completed arch, dome or roof frame stands open to view and can be measured; the centring and the calculation are not.

surface_treatment.reason: A coated sheet shows its finish; the bath, the cleaning and the heat that bonded the coat are not.

surgery.reason: An operation is watched by those in the theatre; the anatomy, the anaesthesia and the judgement of when to cut are not conveyed.

surveying.reason: A surveyor's instrument and chain are seen in the field and his stations marked; the reductions and the checks are done afterwards.

tactics.reason: A manoeuvre or a method of fire is seen in the field; the drill and the data behind it are not.

techniques.reason: Formwork, jacks and sprays are seen on the site; the sequence, the mix and the stressing are known to the crew.

telegraphy.reason: Wires, keys and sounders are in public view; the relays, the batteries and the line balancing are not.

telephone.reason: A handset and switchboard are used in public and their outside is copied; the transmitter and the exchange circuits are inside.

telephony.reason: A telephone exchange and instrument are seen in use; the switching and the transmitter construction are inside.

television.reason: A screen shows a picture; the camera tube, the scanning and the synchronisation are inside sealed cases.

testing.reason: A testing machine is seen and its reading noted; the specimens, the speeds and the interpretation behind its figures are not.

textile_production.reason: Carding, combing and drawing are done in open sheds, and the machinery can be seen and copied.

textiles.reason: A textile machine or appliance is open to view and its parts can be seen and copied; the settings take practice.

theory.reason: A theory of structures or materials is held in the mind of the engineer; the structures show its results, not its reasoning.

therapeutics.reason: A remedy's effect is seen on the patient; its preparation, its strength and the reasons for the dose are held by the maker.

thermodynamics.reason: A cycle is seen as a machine that works; the principle explaining why is not shown by its running.

timekeeping.reason: A clock is seen and heard to keep time and its case opened; the escapement and the setting that keep it true are not.

tooling.reason: A chuck, die or fixture is seen on the bench and its form copied; the fits and the hardening are not.

tools.reason: A surveying tool such as a level or staff is in the open on the work and is copied from sight.

transport.reason: A bridge or a vehicle is open to every traveller and its form is measured and copied; the strength of its members is not.

type.reason: A cast letter shows its face; the punch, the matrix and the metal that give clean letters are made out of sight.

undersea.reason: A bell or a suit is lowered before the crowd and the apparatus seen; the air supply and the pressure practice are not.

urban.reason: Street lighting is on display to the whole town and its fittings are copied from the posts.

vehicle_types.reason: A vehicle is driven in the open and its layout, track and body are seen and copied.

vehicles.reason: An armoured or military vehicle is paraded and examined; its plate and engine are less easily copied.

visual.reason: A mosaic, sculpture or play is shown to the public and its manner copied from the work; the workshop practice is not.

warships.reason: A submarine is seen at the surface; its pressure hull, its ballast control and its propulsion are not shown.

water.reason: A dam, aqueduct or siphon is open to view and can be walked along and measured; the levels and the jointing are less plain.

water_chemistry.reason: Clear water shows nothing of what was added; the dose, the settling and the filtration that cleaned it are done at the works.

water_infrastructure.reason: A penstock, flume or draft tube is in the open and its shape can be measured and copied.

water_prime.reason: A wheel or turbine is seen turning in its race and its buckets and blades copied; the proportions and setting are less plain.

weapons.reason: A weapon is seen in use and its outline copied; the steel, the powder and the boring or rifling that give its performance are not.

weaving.reason: A loom is open to view and its heddles, shuttle and beam are seen and copied; the settings of the shed are not.

wheels_running_gear.reason: Wheels, tyres and bearings are exposed on the vehicle and can be measured and copied; the grade of steel is not.

wind_control.reason: A fantail turns on the roof in full view and its gearing can be seen and copied.

wind_prime.reason: A windmill stands in the open and its sails, tower and gearing can be seen, measured and copied.

writing.reason: A pen, pencil or paper is used before others and its make can be examined and copied; only the lead or ink recipe is not shown.
